title: Level-set splitting of a test form whose support misses {f = t}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous, let t ∈ ℝ, and let η ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (a C^∞ n-form on ℝ^P with compact support whose topological support lies in U) be such that tsupport η is disjoint from {x : f(x) = t}. Then there are η₁, η₂ ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with η = η₁ + η₂, tsupport η₁ ⊆ {x : f(x) < t} and tsupport η₂ ⊆ {x : t < f(x)}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U n), Continuous f → Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) {x | f x = t} → ∃ η₁ η₂ : TestFormOn U n, η = η₁ + η₂ ∧ tsupport (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ {x | f x < t} ∧ tsupport (η₂ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ {x | t < f x}
